description: Build the coordinator Rounds management section: list UI in CoordinatorRoundSection.tsx plus AddRound/EditRound/DeleteRound modals, following CoordinatorCandidatesSection.tsx's layout and AddCandidates.tsx/EditCandidate.tsx's modal pattern. Round delete is a genuine hard delete (useDeleteRound) — confirm copy must say "Delete Round", not "Deactivate", because this action cannot be undone, unlike every other entity in this task. Independent of FEAT-002/003/004 — no shared new code, only shared existing primitives (Modal, Button, Toast, ApiError).
steps: Read src/features/coordinator/components/modals/AddCandidates.tsx and EditCandidate.tsx in full (post Part-A-fix) and src/features/coordinator/components/modals/DeactivateCandidate.tsx — these are the structural templates. Read src/features/coordinator/hooks/useRounds.ts to confirm exact hook signatures (useRounds(pageantId), useCreateRound(pageantId) takes CreateRoundRequest, useUpdateRound(pageantId, roundId) takes UpdateRoundRequest, useDeleteRound(pageantId) takes roundId string) and src/types/round.ts for RoundResponse/RoundType/RoundStatus/CreateRoundRequest/UpdateRoundRequest shapes. Do not modify either file.

Create src/features/coordinator/components/modals/AddRound.tsx: "use client"; a roundFormSchema with zod (name: z.string().min(1).max(150), roundNumber: z.number().int().min(1), roundType: z.enum(["PRELIMINARY","SWIMWEAR","FORMAL_WEAR","TALENT","QUESTION_AND_ANSWER","FINAL","CUSTOM"]), advancementCount: z.number().int().min(0).nullable().optional(), startsAt: z.string().optional(), endsAt: z.string().optional()); export the schema, a RoundFormValues type, and the Field/fieldInput/fieldLabel/fieldError tokens (same dark-navy-form tokens as AddCandidates.tsx, copy verbatim) for EditRound.tsx to import. Add and export two datetime helpers in this file: `toDatetimeLocalInput(iso: string | null): string` (converts RFC3339 to local `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm` via new Date(iso) + manual zero-padded getFullYear/getMonth/getDate/getHours/getMinutes — never use toISOString, that is UTC and shifts the shown time) and `fromDatetimeLocalInput(value: string): string | null` (empty string -> null, else `new Date(value).toISOString()`). Build the Add modal component with props {pageantId, open, onClose}, using useCreateRound(pageantId), react-hook-form + zodResolver, a form with: Name (text input), Round Number (number input), Round Type (select with the 7 RoundType options, human-readable labels e.g. "Question & Answer" for QUESTION_AND_ANSWER), Advancement Count (optional number input), Starts At / Ends At (two <input type="datetime-local"> fields in a 2-col grid, using the helpers for value/onChange via Controller). handleClose() guards `if (createRound.isPending) return;`. Modal size="lg". Toast success/error via useToast/ApiError exactly like AddCandidates.tsx. On submit, convert startsAt/endsAt via fromDatetimeLocalInput before calling mutateAsync, and omit/null them if empty.

Create src/features/coordinator/components/modals/EditRound.tsx mirroring EditCandidate.tsx's structure: props {pageantId, round: RoundResponse | null, onClose}, open derived from !!round, imports roundFormSchema/Field/fieldInput/toDatetimeLocalInput/fromDatetimeLocalInput from "./AddRound", uses useUpdateRound(pageantId, round?.id ?? "") which requires UpdateRoundRequest (CreateRoundRequest fields + required status) so add a Status select (DRAFT/OPEN/CLOSED/FINALIZED) to this form only (Add has no status field since new rounds start as DRAFT per backend default — confirm this assumption is reasonable and proceed), reset() the form from the round prop via useEffect, same handleClose guard and Modal size="lg" as Add.

Create src/features/coordinator/components/modals/DeleteRound.tsx mirroring DeactivateCandidate.tsx exactly in structure but using useDeleteRound(pageantId) (mutateAsync(round.id)), ConfirmModal title "Delete Round", confirmLabel "Delete", destructive, description text that clearly states this is a permanent hard delete (e.g. `Delete "${round.name}"? This action is permanent and cannot be undone — all data for this round will be removed.`), toast.success(`"${round.name}" has been deleted.`) on success.

Rebuild src/features/coordinator/components/management/CoordinatorRoundSection.tsx replacing the stub: "use client", props {pageantId}, useRounds(pageantId) for data, local state for isAddModalOpen/editTarget/deleteTarget. Follow CoordinatorCandidatesSection.tsx's structure exactly: loading skeleton, isError block, header (title "Rounds", subtitle, "+ Add Round" gold button), count line (`${count} round(s)`), empty state (dashed border box, "No rounds yet", "Add your first round" link), then bordered list: desktop grid columns for Round # , Name, Type, Status, Starts/Ends (formatted via a local display formatter using Intl.DateTimeFormat, NOT the datetime-local helpers which are form-only), Actions (Edit/Delete) — plus the md:hidden mobile card block mirroring candidates' pattern. Status badge: 4 variants for DRAFT (slate/muted)/OPEN(green)/CLOSED(bg-navy/10 text-navy border-navy/20)/FINALIZED(bg-gold/10 text-navy border-gold/40), same visual shape as CandidateStatus. Wire the three new modals at the bottom of the returned JSX exactly like CoordinatorCandidatesSection.tsx wires its three.
acceptance_criteria: AddRound.tsx, EditRound.tsx, DeleteRound.tsx exist under src/features/coordinator/components/modals/ and CoordinatorRoundSection.tsx no longer renders the 'Pageant ID: {pageantId}' stub text
DeleteRound.tsx's ConfirmModal uses the word 'Delete' (not 'Deactivate') in both title and confirm button, reflecting that useDeleteRound is a hard delete
`npx tsc --noEmit` run from frontend/ exits 0 with no type errors introduced by these 4 files
CoordinatorRoundSection.tsx visually matches CoordinatorCandidatesSection.tsx's loading/error/empty/list-with-desktop-and-mobile-layouts structure and navy/gold/charcoal/slate Tailwind conventions
verification: cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit — confirm exit code 0
cd frontend && npm run build — confirm the build completes without errors

Manually re-read all 4 touched/created files end-to-end to confirm: Modal size="lg" on Add/Edit, handleClose pending-guard present, toast success/error wired, ConfirmModal 'Delete' wording on DeleteRound, and the datetime-local helpers round-trip correctly (spot check: a RoundResponse with startsAt='2026-01-15T09:00:00Z' produces a sensible local datetime-local string, not shifted by a UTC bug)
findings: Implemented AddRound.tsx, EditRound.tsx, DeleteRound.tsx, and rebuilt CoordinatorRoundSection.tsx exactly per plan. Modal size="lg" on both Add and Edit. handleClose guards are `if (mutation.isPending) return;` only (no isUploadingPhoto — no image field in this form). DeleteRound.tsx uses ConfirmModal with title 'Delete Round' / confirmLabel 'Delete' and permanent-deletion copy, matching useDeleteRound being a hard delete. toDatetimeLocalInput/fromDatetimeLocalInput live in AddRound.tsx and are exported for EditRound.tsx; verified round-trip manually in Node (UTC '2026-01-15T09:00:00Z' -> local 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm' in Asia/Manila -> '2026-01-15T17:00' -> back to '2026-01-15T09:00:00.000Z', so no UTC-shift bug). One deviation from the literal plan text: the Edit form needed its own zod schema (editRoundFormSchema = roundFormSchema.extend({ status })) rather than reusing roundFormSchema's inferred type intersected with `{ status }` inline, because zodResolver's generic Resolver<T> is not covariant/assignable that way under TS — same fields and behavior, just defined as a proper schema so EditRoundFormValues matches zodResolver(editRoundFormSchema) exactly. Both are exported from AddRound.tsx (roundFormSchema/RoundFormValues for Add, editRoundFormSchema/EditRoundFormValues for Edit) so this is additive, not a removal of anything the plan asked for. CoordinatorRoundSection.tsx keeps the stub's existing default export name `RoundSection` (not `CoordinatorRoundSection`) for consistency with CandidatesSection.tsx's export-name-vs-filename pattern. `npx tsc --noEmit` and `npm run build` both pass with 0 errors.
